decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin builds directly on the firm's core plugin development and analytics expertise, and GA4 is now Google's standard, so the firm can interpret results and keep improving it.
Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in 2023, so the plugin has lost its purpose, and the firm's analytics know-how lets it recognise this and move resources to the GA4 version.
Interface and plugin development for connecting shops to retail systems is a core competence, so the firm can assimilate customer feedback and refine the product.
SEO support for shop relaunches combines the firm's established relaunch project experience with its search marketing knowledge, and it already has a page of its own.
